plan.title: Convert RFQ to Auction — Reuse Participants Only

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Create an RFQ-only event for conversion.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding items.
Add the RFQ line item needed for the two vendor bids.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite two vendors so the converted auction can reuse both participants.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can submit quotes.
Submit the first vendor's RFQ quote.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's RFQ quote.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Close the RFQ after both quotes are present so it matches the setup condition.
Open the published RFQ conversion flow and its reuse-options pop-up.

args.goal: On the RFQ-to-Auction conversion pop-up, verify the options to reuse RFQ quotes, participants and weights are shown, select only reuse participants, click Continue, fill the auction configuration without importing RFQ quotes as starting bids, and stop on the converted auction create screen ready to publish

steps.note: Perform and observe the conversion choice that the catalog has no dedicated assertion step for.
Commit the auction schedule after conversion.
Publish the converted auction.
Open the auction participant list to verify participant reuse.
Assert that both RFQ participants were carried into the auction.
Open the auction comparison screen to inspect whether RFQ quotes became starting bids.
Verify that the auction has no imported RFQ prices as starting bids.
